title: Practitioner record requirements and sample kit limits by tier: Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
For the Urology and Continence Supply Program, each payer program decides whether certain catheters are covered only with a practitioner record, how recent a record must be to support a quantity above the monthly allowance, and how many manufacturer sample kits may be sent.

## Terms

- **Coude-tip record required**: whether a coude-tip catheter (A4352) is covered only when a practitioner record shows that a straight-tip catheter cannot be inserted.
- **Closed-system record required**: whether a closed-system catheter with insertion supplies (A4353) is covered only when a practitioner record shows a qualifying condition. The qualifying conditions are nursing facility residence, immunosuppression, vesicoureteral reflux, pregnancy with spinal cord injury, or two documented urinary tract infections within 12 months while using sterile intermittent catheters.
- **Above-allowance record age**: a quantity above the monthly allowance is covered only with a practitioner record of the clinical reason dated within this many calendar months before the ship date. A figure of 0 means the tier has no above-allowance coverage.
- **Sample kits**: the number of no-charge manufacturer sample kits Larkfield may send per program over the rolling 12 months ending on the sample ship date.

## Schedule

| Basis | Continence Self-Pay Program | Continence Commercial HMO Program | Continence Commercial PPO Program | Continence Medicare Advantage Program | Continence Original Medicare Program | Continence Medicaid Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Coude-tip record required | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Closed-system record required | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Above-allowance record age (months before ship date) | 0 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Sample kits per rolling 12 months | 3 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |


## Points of reading

- The Continence Self-Pay Program requires neither record and has no above-allowance coverage, which is why its record age is 0. It may receive 3 sample kits per rolling 12 months; every other tier may receive 2.
